department: Data Science and Engineering (collaborative with South Dakota School of Mines)

deadline.value: Fall-start applicants should apply by the February 15 priority deadline; the final fall deadline is July 15.

app_fee.value: The program's catalog entry lists a non-refundable application fee of $40, above the Graduate School's $38.

toefl_min.value: The program's catalog sets a TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 for applicants from outside the approved English-speaking countries.
toefl_min.quote: a minimum score of 79 on the Internet-Based TOEFL (iBT)

ielts_min.value: The program's catalog sets an IELTS Academic minimum of 6.0 for the same applicants.

english_waiver.value: Applicants with degrees from outside the approved English-speaking countries, including India, must submit a test score.
english_waiver.quote: For all other applicants with degrees from other countries, a minimum score of 79 on the Internet-Based TOEFL (iBT)

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned for this field.

supervisor.value: The catalog asks for a statement of purpose, two letters and a CV, and does not mention faculty agreement.

funding.value: The department page says assistantships are awarded by departments but does not say most students are funded.

entry_route.value: The catalog asks for a bachelor's degree in mathematics, computer science or a closely related field; a master's is not listed as required.
entry_route.quote: Baccalaureate degree in Mathematics, Computer Science or closely related field

also.quote: You may apply 24 credits and six research credits from a previous M.S. degree toward the Ph.D. requirements

notes: Collaborative program run with South Dakota School of Mines; the department page gives 72 credit hours. Fall deadline inferred to the 2026/27 cycle (Feb 15, 2027).
name: Data Science and Engineering PhD
